name: EmojiRain
description: Physics-based EmojiRain using Matter.js and DOM sprites. Includes custom emoji sets, user mappings, uploads, SuperFan bursts, heart balloons, gift balls, presets, GCCE commands, Flow actions, and TikTok LIVE integration.
author: Pup Cid

descriptions.en: Physics-based EmojiRain with Matter.js, custom assets, heart balloons, gift balls, presets, and TikTok LIVE integration.
descriptions.de: Physikbasierter EmojiRain mit Matter.js, eigenen Assets, Herzballons, Geschenkekugeln, Presets und TikTok-LIVE-Integration.
descriptions.es: EmojiRain basado en física con Matter.js, recursos personalizados, globos de corazón, bolas de regalo, presets e integración con TikTok LIVE.
descriptions.fr: EmojiRain basé sur la physique avec Matter.js, ressources personnalisées, ballons-cœurs, boules-cadeaux, préréglages et intégration TikTok LIVE.
